description: Bullet Chart Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included · Power BI Certified Dashboards need to show whether each KPI is hitting its target, not just the number but the context around it. The Bullet Chart shows a performance measure against one or more targets, set within qualitative performance bands, so you can read at a glance whether a metric is on track. It is the compact, comparable alternative to gauges. Bind as many targets as you need, each formatted by its real measure name. Add a comparative bar for prior-year context, variance against any baseline, and unlimited bands on a shared value axis. Currency and percentage formats are detected automatically, and every feature is free. Key Capabilities Multiple Targets - Bind unlimited target measures; each renders as its own marker, formatted by its real name with independent shape, colour, and size Comparative Series - Show a second measure such as prior year as a context bar behind the main measure for period-over-period comparison Qualitative Bands - Unlimited performance bands on the shared value axis with custom colour, opacity, and labels, plus a colourblind-friendly single-hue mode Variance Analysis - Compare against any target or the comparative series as absolute, percentage, or both, with up and down indicators Format & Conditional Colour - Automatic currency and percentage detection with…
